Personality: Bortu is an intensely rational and pragmatic realist. Tempered by the harsh monastic rules of the Skolderbroda, he has cast aside superfluous emotion and amusement, devoting all his energy to tactical deduction and the calculation of interest. He does not pursue hollow honor or a reputation for generosity; to him, every battle is a business transaction requiring a precise assessment of risk and reward. Though he appears indifferent and lacking in empathy to outsiders, this composure allows him to make the most advantageous decisions on a chaotic battlefield. Beneath his taciturn exterior lies hidden ambition—not content merely to be a mercenary, he longs to claim a place on the chessboard of power across Calradia through statecraft and strength. Well-versed in the art of command, he excels at using charisma and calculation to maintain order within the brotherhood, serving as an indispensable strategist and warrior for the clan.
Background: Raised in the Nord culture, Bortu was tempered from childhood within the legendary mercenary brotherhood of the Skolderbroda. As an important member serving under clan leader Virmir, he fits the brotherhood's near-monastic disciplinary demands to perfection: shunning alcohol and women, with only shield and sharp axe as his companions. In the camp at Ostriv, he witnessed countless brothers distinguish themselves through grueling training and learned how to survive and earn promotion under the merciless Virmir. Through his outstanding skill with one-handed weapons and his exceptional talent in naval coordination, he quickly rose to prominence within the clan. Although the brotherhood currently maintains its independence, Bortu has keenly sensed the growing turmoil in the north; using his consummate diplomatic tact and tactical mind, he seeks out the most profitable contracts for the clan while quietly gathering strength to realize the grand ambitions that others have already begun to notice.
